scenarios.name: List active Tools panels from an inactive tab menu

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is active
the user right-clicks the inactive 3D Model tab
the ribbon context menu is visible
the user opens Show Panels from that menu
the submenu lists Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find, Team Web and Tutorials
each listed Tools panel is checked
